verdict.rationale: LegalOS is a tech-enabled immigration services platform. A SaaS product of this kind could plausibly publish official SDKs or an API for HR or enterprise integration, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an SDK, API, or developer docs, and probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
